title: Works Great!
text: Works Great!. Overall, it was easy enough to assemble. There are a couple of parts that you need to really pay close attention to the directions because it is easy to get it backwards and require you taking it off and putting it back on correctly. The finished unit is sturdy. My daughter has this in her apartment as a TV stand. Her TV isn't very big, so she didn't need something over sized. The shelves work well for her video game consoles.

product_metadata.title: SOOWERY Console Table with Charging Station, 32'' Entryway Table with Doors, Sofa Table Narrow Long with 3 Tiers Open Wood Storage Shelves, for Living Room, Entryway, Foyer, Brown
features: Console Table with USB Ports and Outlets - SOOWERY console table offers you the convenience of 2 USB ports & 2 power outlets. You are able to charge multiple electronic devices and household appliances, such as TV, lamps, cellphones, tablets, coffee machines etc.

Designed with Your Electricity Safety in Mind - The Charging Station is Designed on Your Left/Right Vertical Side, which is safer to use. You don’t have to worry about electric shock caused by spilled coffee, water, etc. And, it doesn't take up any space on the tabletop.

With 2 Door-type Cabinets - This skinny console table is designed with two storage cabinets instead of drawers, and the door-style cabinets don't need to be pulled out, making them more suitable for narrow spaces.

Ample Storage Space - This entryway table with storage shelves gives you a large storage space, you can place big household appliances on the top, and store your items in the drawers or the 2-layer wooden divider below.

Elegant Style & Multiple Functional - The narrow console table for entryway can fit any spot. The wood veneer looks elegant. Totally 2 cabinets and 3 open tiers for display and storage. You can use it as an entryway table with shoe storage, behind couch table, foyer table, wall table, front door table, TV console table for living room, gaming console table, hallway table.
